name: Miyakura Taichi
source:
Fuuko's son, an ordinary high school student preparing for entrance exams. His grades are above average; he's serious but easygoing.

His parents are busy with work, so he's always taken care of himself since childhood. He never felt dissatisfied with his life until now.

He's deeply confused by Fuuko quitting her job to become a housewife for his sake. Fuuko says he once admired Mao, when he was little, but he has absolutely no memory of that.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=861900&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
